newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Tyson bite disastrous for Filipino fans, lovers.
newsitem.headline: Tyson bite disastrous for Filipino fans, lovers.

text.p: A Filipino man was shot dead and another beaten in brawls while a third lost his love after Mike Tyson lost to Evander Holyfield in their heavyweight title fight, a Philippine newspaper said on Wednesday.

A Holyfield fan in the northern Philippine town of Munoz shot and killed his drinking partner during a quarrel over the fight last weekend after watching it on television, the newspaper Today said, quoting belated police reports.
Tyson was disqualified by the referee after biting Holyfield in both ears in their fight in Las Vegas, Nevada.
A Tyson supporter in Munoz town was beaten by a neighbour after he refused to pay a 30,000 peso ($1,140) bet, it added.
Another Tyson admirer, who was courting a village lass in San Isidro town, also came to grief.
The girl's father, a Holyfield fanatic, barred him from further seeing his daughter, Today said.
